card.name: Ryu Kokki
card.summary: No fim da Etapa de Dano, destrói o monstro enfrentado se for do Tipo Warrior ou Spellcaster.

textEvidence.text: Ryu Kokki has 2400 ATK, 2000 DEF, Level 6, DARK Zombie. At the end of the Damage Step after this monster battles an opponent's Warrior or Spellcaster monster, that opponent's battling monster is destroyed if still on the field. Ordinary damage calculation and battle damage happen first. This effect applies whether Ryu Kokki attacks or defends, including if Ryu Kokki itself was destroyed in that battle. An opponent of any other Type does not activate the effect; Skill Drain negates it while Ryu Kokki is face-up. There are no costs, optional choices, or additional printed effects.

card.name: Getsu Fuhma
card.summary: No fim da Etapa de Dano, destrói o monstro enfrentado se for do Tipo Fiend ou Zombie.

textEvidence.text: Getsu Fuhma has 1700 ATK, 1200 DEF, Level 4, DARK Warrior. At the end of the Damage Step after this monster battles an opponent's Fiend or Zombie monster, destroy that opponent's battling monster if it remains on the field, independently of who won the battle by ordinary attack and defense values. The rule also applies while defending and after the source itself is destroyed by that battle. Battle damage is dealt before this destruction. Other Types do not qualify. Skill Drain negates this monster effect while the source is face-up. The card has no optional choice, cost, or additional printed effect.

card.name: Aranha Mecânica
card.summary: Após o cálculo de dano, se atacar um monstro TREVAS, destrua o alvo do ataque.

textEvidence.text: Karakuri Spider has 400 ATK, 500 DEF, Level 2, EARTH Machine. If Karakuri Spider attacks a DARK monster, destroy the attacked monster after damage calculation if it remains on the field, regardless of which monster won the battle, provided the attacking Spider's effect was not negated. Damage calculation still happens as usual. This effect does not apply when Karakuri Spider is attacked, when the target is not DARK, or to any monster outside that battle. There is no activation cost, optional choice, or additional printed mechanic. Its historic OCG debut was in Booster 4 in 1999.
